Body.Content:
We are announcing the ability to reconcile multiple resources and date ranges in a single action in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026.

How does this affect me?
When this feature is enabled, users can select multiple time durations and resources on the Resource Reconciliation grid. This feature allows users to:
  • Select multiple time durations on the grid.
  • Select multiple users on the grid.
  • Extend the bookings for selections done on the grid.
This reduces repetitive, one-at-a-time reconciliation and helps project teams align bookings and assignments more efficiently.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

If you would like more information on this feature, please visit Perform bulk reconciliation of bookings from UI.

message.Title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Perform bulk reconciliation of bookings from UI
